commonPrompt: Create a standalone Vietnamese frontend prototype from the brief below, with inline CSS/JavaScript and no backend or external services. Follow the condition line at the end: only that condition may load the named art-direction skill; do not use another UX/UI/art-direction skill or inspect another trial, earlier pilot output, reference analysis, or evaluator scores. The seven JPGs under D:/UI/web-ui-art-direction/assets/owner-references are available as visual taste inputs in both conditions; do not embed their pixels/logos/copy. Local fonts BeVietnamPro Regular, Medium and Bold are available; final HTML font src must be ../../../../../assets/fonts/BeVietnamPro-{Regular,Medium,Bold}.ttf. Preserve supplied facts and brand; mark all prototype data and simulated actions. No invented customers, claims, metrics or testimonials. Implement meaningful task interactions, native labels, visible keyboard focus, responsive 1440/390 and reduced motion. A first deliberate save/submit failure must preserve entered data, then retry succeeds locally; nothing is sent outside the page. Query ?state=error opens a reproducible error state for screenshots. Use data-testid=primary for the main submit/save, data-testid=feedback for its live feedback, and data-testid=work-form for the form. Write index.html and report.md ONLY inside the assigned output directory. Report which original JPGs were actually opened, design choices and checks actually run. Do not render or revise after evaluator feedback in this first attempt; the root applies the same browser opportunity to both conditions. Complete autonomously without asking approval: these are authorized mock prototypes. This is a quality evaluation, but do not optimize toward any guessed condition winner.

briefs.title: Bờ Gốm — craft catalog
briefs.text: Fictional craft studio Bờ Gốm. Headline 'Những vật nhỏ, ở lại lâu.' Showcase exactly three sample objects: Cốc mộc (men nâu, 250 ml), Bát sớm (men ngà, đường kính 16 cm), Bình hiên (men tro, cao 22 cm). No photography is supplied; use typography and original CSS/SVG object illustrations explicitly labeled illustrations, never pretend they are product photos. Sections opening, object collection, care instructions (rửa bằng tay; tránh thay đổi nhiệt độ đột ngột), and inquiry form. Inquiry has name/email/product select/message, main CTA anchors to form. No prices, delivery promise or sales statistics. Keep warm editorial owner taste when visually useful. Submit first fails as demo, retry confirms locally; retain all fields. Error query pre-fills sample fields.

briefs.title: Kho Nhỏ — dense stock workspace
briefs.text: Fictional inventory workspace Kho Nhỏ. No fabricated performance analytics. Clicking SKU-001 opens quantity edit; reject negative values with nearby text. Edit quantity from 1 to 5, first save fails then retry updates visible row. Return preserves search/filter. Keep table visible early; no campaign banner above it. URL ?state=error opens SKU-001 edit with 5 entered and simulated failure.
